title: Faculty Positions: National Biomedical Imaging Center, College of Future Technology, PKU - Beijing (CN) job with National Biomedical Imaging Center, College of Future Technology, Peking University | 12866840
gist: A Nature Careers job ad (not a research article): Peking University's National Biomedical Imaging Center, which operates the Multimodal Trans-Scale Biomedical Imaging Facility in Huairou, Beijing, is recruiting faculty globally, prioritizing imaging systems, probes/sensors, spatial omics, AI/big data and digital-life modeling.

insights.claim: Peking University's National Biomedical Imaging Center (NBIC), established in 2020 under the College of Future Technology, builds and operates the Multimodal Trans-Scale Biomedical Imaging Facility in Huairou District, Beijing.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Signals China's state-backed build-out of large-scale biomedical imaging infrastructure, a demand source for imaging instruments and probes.
insights.quote: constructs and operates the Multimodal Trans-Scale Biomedical Imaging Facility located in Huairou District, Beijing

insights.claim: PKU's NBIC runs platforms spanning multimodal medical imaging, live-cell imaging, high-resolution molecular imaging, integrated data processing and model-animal research, aimed at imaging living organisms from molecular structures to whole organs.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Breadth of platforms indicates a full-stack Chinese imaging hub that could compete with or procure from Western imaging/microscopy vendors.

insights.claim: PKU's NBIC positions imaging platforms as tools to decipher complex-disease mechanisms and accelerate drug discovery.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Imaging-driven drug discovery capacity in China adds to the domestic biotech R&D ecosystem.
insights.quote: researchers can decipher mechanisms underlying complex diseases, accelerate drug discovery

themes.theme: Recruiting priorities: AI and digital life

insights.claim: PKU's National Biomedical Imaging Center is recruiting faculty in priority areas including imaging theory and systems, probe and sensor development, imaging-based spatial omics, big data/AI/quantitative biology, and digital-life modeling.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Hiring priorities flag where Chinese academic biomedical-imaging investment is heading: AI-enabled imaging, spatial omics and novel probes.

insights.claim: PKU's NBIC frames its agenda as the imaging-based digitization and intelligent transformation of traditional life-science research, plus disruptive biotechnologies built on novel algorithms, instruments and probes.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: The 'digital life' framing aligns imaging with AI/data infrastructure, a theme to watch in AI-for-biology.
insights.quote: imaging-based digitization and intelligent transformation of traditional life-science research

insights.claim: PKU's NBIC is hiring across both a faculty track (assistant to tenured full professor) and a research track (research assistant to research professor), with competitive salary and start-up packages; applications close 17 Jan 2027.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Senior-level global recruitment indicates continued Chinese talent competition in biomedical imaging and AI-biology.
